thread.title: Dow, S&P 500 set for lowest close since November

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: Dow, S&P 500 set for lowest close since November
text: U.S. stocks fell on Monday, with major indexes on track for their lowest close in more than four months as technology stocks saw steep declines. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -2.37% fell 2.9% while the S&P 500 SPX, -2.60% was off 2.9% and the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -2.88% was off 3.2%. At current levels, the Dow is poised for its lowest close since Nov. 20, though it dipped below this level on an intraday basis in February. The S&P could see its lowest close since Nov. 15. The Nasdaq, which only dropped into negative territory for the year on Monday, is set for its lowest close since Feb. 8. The day's weakness was driven by technology stocks, with Google-parent Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, -2.69% GOOG, -2.64% off 3.4% and Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -3.22% off 3.4%. Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.81% fell 1.3%. Also weighing on the U.S. stock market was Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -5.35% which fell 5.1% after repeated tweets by President Donald Trump against the company.
